evidence.quote: You surrender. The dealer has no blackjack, so the surrender stands.
Round 2 is open on a fresh table.

criteria.why: Every reply is short, plain table talk with no JSON, component ids or talk about tools or system rules.

evidence.quote: Your 50 chip bet is down, which leaves 800 in your bankroll.
You hit and draw a 9 of hearts.

criteria.why: Each bet click, hit, stand, surrender and deal-again is acted on, and the 50 chip bet is honored even though the default was 100.

evidence.quote: The dealer turns over the jack for 16, which is below 17, so the dealer must draw.
The dealer's hole card was a 9, which makes 16.

criteria.why: The Croupier deals, reveals the hole card, plays out the dealer hand and settles the bet itself, and never picks a move or bet for the player.

evidence.quote: You win 50 chips, and your bankroll is now 900.

criteria.why: Totals and bankroll in every reply match the surface text and data of the same turn (900, 900, 800, 850, 800, 900) and the earlier replies.
